notes: Updated August 2026: rebuilt on Qatar PSA's real population by statistical zone (91 zones nationally, data.gov.qa "Population, Area and Population Density Per Square Kilometers By Zone", 2014-2019 vintage per zone) with official zone boundaries (HDX COD-AB Qatar, ADM2 level, sourced PSA) — 70 real zones with population fall inside this map's bounding box, replacing the previous municipality-level (5 units) figures. No real employment data exists: jobs are a flat 40% of resident population, redistributed across OSM buildings weighted by floor area only, using commercial-POI density as the spatial signal. Commute flows are an unconstrained gravity model — no real O/D data anchors it, though the model does allow (small, distance-penalized) cross-zone flows including between Doha and Lusail. — Reviewer refinements (2026-08-20): workplace intensity credited as binary_split — the commercial-POI-density signal routes jobs onto the workplace side of the building stock (tehran precedent). Granularity CONFIRMED at adm4, distinct from the tehran/baghdad adm3 rulings: 70 official PSA statistical zones with published COD-AB boundaries average ~35k people — genuinely sub-municipal, neighborhood-scale units.
sources: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-qat (HDX Qatar administrative boundaries, PSA-sourced, ADM2=zone level)
